Dimension of Lot Approximately: PARK PLACE
Nearest Cross Street: MONTPELIER STREET
Known as and designated as Unit No. 162 in Building 40 Situated in Park Place ll @ Tinton Falls Condominium, a condominium, established in accordance with the New Jersey Condominium Act (N.J.S.A 48:8b-1, et seq.) together with an undivided .20832 percentage of interest in the General Common elements of said condominium appurtenant to the aforesaid unit in accordance with and subject to the terms and conditions, covenants, restrictions, reservations easements, lien as for assesements, and other provisions as set forth in the current Master Deed of Park Place ll @Tinton Falls Condominium, dated July 19, 1990, recorded July 26, 1990, in the Office of the Monmouth Clerk/Register in Deed Book 5016, Page 83 et seq. amended in Deed Book 5027 page 59; Deed Book 5049 page 222; Deed Book 5062 page 621; Deed Book 5125 page 13; Deed Book 5408 page 695; Deed Book 5610, Page 733; Deed Book 5736, Page 718; Deed Book 5928 page 136, Book OR-8167 Page 7535; as same may now or hereafter be lawfully amended.
PRIOR LIENS/ENCUMBRANCES
4TH QTR TAXES OPEN $1,603.68
SEWER OPEN PLUS PENALTY $399.58
TOTAL AS OF NOVEMBER 5, 2025: $2,003..26
Good faith estimate of upset price: $326,012.28
The occupancy status of the property being foreclosed herein is presently unknown.
